SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leads WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURRENT_DATE) as new_today,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leads WHERE status = 'hot') as total_hot,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leads WHERE status = 'converted' AND DATE(updated_at) = CURRENT_DATE) as converted_today,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM conversations WHERE DATE(sent_at) = CURRENT_DATE) as messages_today,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leads) as total_leads,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM payments WHERE status = 'captured' AND DATE(created_at) = CURRENT_DATE) as revenue_today,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM payments WHERE status = 'captured' AND DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) = DATE_TRUNC('month', NOW())) as revenue_month

SELECT l.name, l.phone, l.score, l.status, c.name as brand
FROM leads l
LEFT JOIN clients c ON l.client_id = c.id
WHERE l.status = 'hot'
ORDER BY l.score DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT c.phone_number_id, c.wa_access_token
FROM clients c
WHERE c.wa_access_token IS NOT NULL
  AND c.phone_number_id IS NOT NULL
LIMIT 1
